measurementNotes: Local comparisons use the exact frozen P17 shared semantic compiler. Structural comparisons are retained separately because their images differ; neither is relabelled as the other. Earlier pre-cutover consumer reports retain their own identities and decisions.

All final timing processes ran after this task’s builds and non-timing platform probes stopped. Three alternating process windows plus two confirmations for suspected regressions; three warmups and nine samples per process. No exclusive-host claim.

Loop scalar evaluation counts and guard counts are measured by stepping native World one logical instruction at a time. They are not a latency inference. Guarded live-zero values remain unchanged; dead total scalars may compute once on a zero trip under the semantic contract.

WASM working payload excludes host buffers and RSS. Quantum-one and quantum-64 cycles are separate. Admission repeats identical images across input lengths; grouped memory rows retain their actual paths.

The common preheader rewrite removes initial unnecessary guard copies. Initial guard-only images and measurements remain separately attributed by their emitter and image hashes. The guarded fallback is retained for its distinct live-zero-value obligation and is included in final costs.
The 18 Agent images remain byte-identical to P17; no real-Agent gain is claimed. Construction observations are not paired application-speed evidence.
M3/P13/P16 decisions and later packages/final bindings/reviews remain open.
